claim: Through the AWS Config integration, results of AWS Config managed and custom rule evaluations appear as findings in Security Hub CSPM; AWS Config sends them through Amazon EventBridge. Only evaluations performed after Security Hub CSPM was enabled are sent, and evaluations from service-linked AWS Config rules, such as those that run checks for Security Hub CSPM controls, are excluded (except service-linked rules that AWS Control Tower creates and manages).

qualifiers.condition: service-linked Config rules used by CSPM controls are excluded

evidence.quote: By using the integration with AWS Config, you can see the results of AWS Config managed and custom rule evaluations as findings in Security Hub CSPM.
AWS Config uses Amazon EventBridge to send AWS Config rule evaluations to Security Hub CSPM.
Only evaluations that were performed after Security Hub CSPM was enabled are sent.

Evaluations from [service-linked AWS Config rules](securityhub-setup-prereqs.md), such as those used to run checks for Security Hub CSPM controls, are excluded. The exception is findings generated by service-linked rules that AWS Control Tower creates and manages in AWS Config.
